changes.text: Fixed issue that required the target to be held for it to do damage.
The aura on this power should now taunt non-raid tagged foes. Changed the power description for clarity.
The aura on this power should now taunt non-raid tagged foes.

This power can now slot Accuracy boosts.
Special Assault Suits now change costume and play an FX at 25% HP to provide 'near death' visual cues to players for informing them of imminent incoming on-defeat debuffs.
Removed leftover references to Dr. Engles.
Changed Portal Tech to Portal Corp in Dr. Francois clues.
Fixed Council Sonic Blast, Heavy Sonic Blast, and Cannon Heavy Sonic Blast rifle FX.

Fixed AI for Ruin Possessed Scientists.

Ambushing Red Caps now correctly Ignore Combat Mods.
Separated Pumpkin Patch behavior against players and critters; Lowered player damage scale to 0.22 from 0.3, and critter to 0.11 from 0.3.
Fixed various typos in descriptions, powers, and strings.
